answer: Resist sybils by making weight non-transferable and slow to mint: a new key starts at zero until it finishes a time-gated, non-parallelizable chore sequence that hardens into a unique basalt record of on-ledger work no farm can rush in one burst. Voting power then accrues only from a reef of inbound attestations tied to that exact key, so clones cannot share one reputation. A sudden dune of near-identical keys that share timing or phrasing is collapsed and slashed together, making mass minting costlier than earning one honest history.
